title: SHINE Finding — v8.1
description: Schema for a single finding emitted by a SHINE subagent and validated by the orchestrator at Stage 5a. v8.1 introduces structured location, three-field provenance (subagentRaw / voiceNormalized / controllerEdited), mandatory version stamps, evergreen-accepted state, reconciler attribution, and citation discipline for L9/L12.

id.description: Stable insertion-order identifier assigned by the orchestrator at Stage 5b. Subagents leave this null; orchestrator fills it.

layer.description: L1..L14 per the 14-layer model. L0 reserved for orchestrator-emitted entity-verification findings.

enum: Statement of Changes in Partners Capital
statement.description: FS statement group. Drives v7 statement-grouped dashboard rendering. Cross-Statement is reserved for findings spanning multiple statements that cannot be cleanly localized.

section.description: Statement-internal section label (e.g., 'Investments at fair value', 'Level 3 reconciliation', 'Related party transactions'). Required — Stage 5a rejects findings without this.

sortOrder.description: Within-statement sort key. Orchestrator sorts findings in FS page order using sortOrder ascending within a statement group. Required.

line_id.description: Specific line item, e.g., 'Total investments at fair value', 'Management fee'

column.description: Column label when relevant, e.g., 'Current Year', 'Prior Year'

xlsx_cell.description: Workbook cell reference if sourced from workbook, e.g., 'BS!C24'

location.description: v8.1 structured location. Required object with at minimum a statement key. Stage 5a rejects findings missing this.

subagentRaw.description: Immutable original finding text from the subagent. NEVER overwritten.

voiceNormalized.description: Optional polished version produced by orchestrator Stage 5g voice annotation. Null when no polish was warranted. Polish removes hedging on CERTAIN only; PROBABLE/POSSIBLE keep their hedging.

controllerEdited.description: Controller's edited text from inline-edit mode. Null when the controller has not edited. When set, dashboard displays this version with an '(edited)' badge.

fix.description: Recommended remediation. Backward-compat field that mirrors the active fix (controller edited > polished > raw).

fixSubagentRaw.description: Immutable original fix text from the subagent.

asc_reference.description: Required on every L9 finding. Pattern: 'ASC <topic>-<subtopic>-<section>-<paragraph>' e.g., 'ASC 820-10-50-2'.

regulatory_citation.description: Required on every L12 finding. Format '<JURISDICTION>:<KEY>' e.g., 'CIMA:MFA-4', 'SEC:RULE-206-4-2'. Must resolve to an entry in reference/regulatory-corpus/_index.json.

quoted_text.description: Excerpt from the FS draft supporting the finding.

xlsx_proof.description: Workbook cell reference and value proving the tie-out break.

prior_text.description: Excerpt from prior FS or sibling FS used in comparative findings.

merge_key.description: Computed at Stage 5c. Format: '<statement>::<section>::<line_id_or_norm>::<finding_class>'. Used for dedup and reconciler clustering.

evergreen_accepted.description: Controller mark indicating this finding represents an accepted documented practice. Skips severity escalation; excluded from readiness-gate count.

reconciler_pattern.description: Name of cross-layer pattern that collapsed constituent findings into this root cause. Null when no collapse occurred.

constituent_findings.description: When reconciler_pattern is non-null, this lists the constituent finding IDs collapsed into this root cause. Dashboard exposes via 'Show constituents' toggle and allows decoupling.

subagent_version.description: Version of the subagent SKILL.md that produced this finding. Required for audit reproducibility.

prompt_version.description: Version tag of the dispatch prompt template used by the orchestrator.

reference_versions.description: Map of reference file name → version/date hash for every reference doc the subagent consulted in producing this finding.

state.description: Disposition state set by controller via dashboard at Stage 8.

discard_attestation.description: Required one-line attestation when a finding is DISCARDED if the review's discard rate exceeds 20%.

detail.description: Supplementary structured detail, cross-references to sibling findings, etc.
